messages:
Micah: Heads-up — EU onboarding embedding ingest failures hit ~27 tenants between 02:10–05:05 UTC. Customers seeing partial imports, retries, and timeouts. We need a segmented comms sweep (email + in-app banner + translation) and to capture feedback/renewal flags. Draft below, please weigh in.

Ana: Can you post the list of affected tenants + any with renewals in next 60 days? I’ll prioritize outreach.

Jordan: What’s the ETA for full remediation? Customers asking for timeline in support threads.

Leo: Root cause = retry storm from outdated NATS client + backpressure on the ingestion queue. Short-term mitigation: pause the ingestion workers for the problematic batch, restart consumers with rate limit patch. Full rollback/fix rolling out in ~90–120m.

Micah: OK — thanks. Draft customer message (short + actionable):

```
Subject: Brief outage impacting data ingest for some onboarding accounts (EU region)

Hi — we detected an ingestion disruption that affected imports for a subset of EU onboarding accounts between 02:10–05:05 UTC. Engineers have applied a mitigation and are rolling out a fix; most tenants should finish ingest within the next 2–4 hours.

What we’re doing: paused the problematic batch, restarted consumers with a rate-limit patch, and are monitoring progress.

Impact: imports may appear incomplete or paused. If you see missing records after 6 hours, please reply and we’ll prioritize a manual replay.

Credits & next steps: for affected tenants we’ll issue a credit for the affected ingest window. We’ll follow up with an RCA within 48 hours and offer a 1:1 office hours session for high-touch accounts.

If this is impacting onboarding or renewals, reply here or book time: <office-hours-link>

— The Redwood Inference Team
```

Jordan: Recommend also an in-app banner that links to the above short message + support thread. I’ll queue the banner once we have the final copy.

cs-bot: Incident created: INC-20260322-EMB-042 — link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-20260322-EMB-042

Ana: I’ll handle FR/DE/ES translations and coordinate localized emails. Can someone confirm the exact list of accounts and renewal windows?

Sarah: Flagging renewals — please tag accounts with renewals in next 90 days. I’ll prepare tailored outreach and suggest offering an expanded office-hours slot.

Leo: Fix rollout is progressing; patch applied to first 30% of consumers. Metrics look good (queue depth decreasing). I expect the bulk to clear in ~2h. We’ll post an update when the queue is under normal thresholds.

Micah: Feedback capture: can we attach a short 3-question form in the follow-up email to understand onboarding impact + whether the credit/office hours are sufficient?

Jordan: Yup — suggested items: 1) Did your ingest succeed after remediation? 2) How did this affect your onboarding timeline? 3) Would a 1:1 help? Link: https://forms.example/redd-insert

Ana: Will update translations with that form link. I’ll also surface any customers requesting immediate manual replays.

Sarah: For renewal-risk customers, I propose a personal email and a scheduled 30-min troubleshooting slot. I’ll share a spreadsheet of proposed contacts by EOD.

Micah: Action owners: @Ana translations + localized sends; @Jordan in-app banner + support thread update; @Leo confirm full queue drain and post remediation metric update; @Sarah compile renewal-risk list and coordinate high-touch offers.

Leo: Noted. I’ll post a metric snapshot when the queue < 500 messages.

Jordan: Will send the banner + email draft after micah confirms final copy.

Ana: :thumbsup: I’ll start translations now.

Sarah: Thanks. Let’s reconvene in 2 hours for the RCA outline and customer follow-ups.

Micah: Perfect — thanks everyone. I’ll publish the short comm and ping once we have the verified account list.

(THREAD END)
